method: streaming chat completions; unique prefix per run to avoid prefix-cache reuse; 64 output tokens with ignore_eos=true
note: The model card's directly validated runtime is SGLang at 2048 context. These long-context vLLM figures are measurements taken on this host (NVIDIA DGX Spark / GB10, aarch64) and are not vendor-validated results.
caveat: Not directly comparable to the MTP2/MTP3 runs in results/: this baseline generates 64 tokens with ignore_eos and deliberately bypasses the prefix cache, while the MTP runs generate 2048-4096 tokens at temperature 0.2 with prefix caching enabled. See README section 10.
